day5_start.name: Me
day5_start.text: *Sunday morning. Sunlight seeps through the curtain gap, painting stripes across the blanket.*

day5_morning_wake.name: Me
day5_morning_wake.text: *I opened my eyes. Waking up on my own without an alarm— that hasn't happened in a while. Clock— 8 AM. Not bad for a Sunday.*

day5_morning_stretch.name: Me
day5_morning_stretch.text: *I stretched and stared up at the ceiling. Morning number five. This ceiling's starting to feel familiar.*

day5_morning_think.name: Me
day5_morning_think.text: *Hard to believe it's only been four days since I transferred. Feels more like a month. Every hour was packed.*

day5_morning_mirror.name: Me
day5_morning_mirror.text: *Washed my face and stood in front of the mirror. The person staring back has— how do I put it— different eyes than a few days ago.*

day5_morning_mirror2.name: Me
day5_morning_mirror2.text: *A new classroom, new people. And encounters I never saw coming. Can this much really happen in four days?*

day5_morning_phone_check.name: Me
day5_morning_phone_check.text: *I picked up my phone from the bed. One notification on the screen.*

day5_couple_msg_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_couple_msg_seoyeon.text: "If you're up early, come see the garden. That flower I mentioned yesterday— I think it's blooming today. ☀️ Front gate."

day5_couple_react_seoyeon.name: Me
day5_couple_react_seoyeon.text: *Timing her morning around a flower— that's so Seoyeon. Seamlessly slotting me into her plans with that effortless composure.*

day5_couple_reply_seoyeon.name: Me
day5_couple_reply_seoyeon.text: (I started typing "Want me to grab coffee on the way?" then deleted it and sent "There's a place I want to show you, too.")

day5_couple_msg_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_couple_msg_yuna.text: "...You up? School today. Front gate. 10. I'm leaving if you're late."

day5_couple_react_yuna.name: Me
day5_couple_react_yuna.text: (Short. Classic Yuna short. But "I'm leaving if you're late" clearly means she'll wait.)

day5_couple_reply_yuna.name: Me
day5_couple_reply_yuna.text: ("I won't be late." A plain reply— but the hand setting down my phone trembled slightly.)

day5_couple_msg_dain.name: Dain
day5_couple_msg_dain.text: "WAKE UP!!!! Let's go to school today!! Front gate!! Don't you DARE be late!! I'm literally gonna sprint there!! ☀️🏐"

day5_couple_react_dain.name: Me
day5_couple_react_dain.text: *Seven exclamation marks. Her morning energy could shatter the screen. But honestly, messages like this make me jump out of bed.*

day5_couple_reply_dain.name: Me
day5_couple_reply_dain.text: ("Lol don't run, you'll trip. I won't be late." I sent back. But knowing her, she's definitely sprinting.)

day5_couple_msg_nurse.name: Nurse
day5_couple_msg_nurse.text: "Sleep well? I'm kind of excited about meeting up this weekend. Let's meet in front of the school. I'll be in regular clothes, so you might not recognize me 💕"

day5_couple_react_nurse.name: Me
day5_couple_react_nurse.text: *That heart emoji sent heat all the way to my earlobes. Meeting outside of school is definitely a different vibe.*

day5_couple_reply_nurse.name: Me
day5_couple_reply_nurse.text: ("I'm looking forward to it. 10 o'clock." I wrote it formally, then paused. What tone is even right here? I sent it as-is.)

day5_couple_msg_teacher.name: Teacher
day5_couple_msg_teacher.text: "I have something to take care of at school today. Front gate, 10 AM. You'd better not be late."

day5_couple_react_teacher.name: Me
day5_couple_react_teacher.text: ("Something to take care of"— playing it cool, but she's the one who texted first. That flimsy excuse is actually kind of endearing.)

day5_couple_reply_teacher.name: Me
day5_couple_reply_teacher.text: ("I won't be late!" Short reply. Did she smile reading it, too?)

day5_pending_msg_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_pending_msg_seoyeon.text: "Free today? I need someone to check the garden with me. No pressure— you can totally say no 😅"

day5_pending_react_seoyeon.name: Me
day5_pending_react_seoyeon.text: (Seoyeon's reaching out. "No pressure" she says, but the moment she sent this, we both know I'm going.)

day5_pending_reply_seoyeon.name: Me
day5_pending_reply_seoyeon.text: (Today, I have to tell her. "I'll be there. Front gate." I replied. My fingertips are cold.)

day5_pending_msg_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_pending_msg_yuna.text: "...School today. Can you come? ...I need to tell you something."

day5_pending_react_yuna.name: Me
day5_pending_react_yuna.text: ("I need to tell you something"— those words dropped my heart into my stomach. This is the first time Yuna's ever said she has something to say.)

day5_pending_reply_yuna.name: Me
day5_pending_reply_yuna.text: (I have something I want to say, too. "Yeah, I'll come." Brief. Not that I learned that from Yuna or anything.)

day5_pending_msg_dain.name: Dain
day5_pending_msg_dain.text: "Hey! Wanna come to school today?! Got a sec after practice?! It's important!!"

day5_pending_react_dain.name: Me
day5_pending_react_dain.text: (She said "important." It's rare for Dain— the exclamation mark queen— to sound this serious.)

day5_pending_reply_dain.name: Me
day5_pending_reply_dain.text: (There's something I need to say today, too. "I'll be there!! Wait for me!" — I borrowed her exclamation marks.)

day5_pending_msg_nurse.name: Nurse
day5_pending_msg_nurse.text: "Coming to school today? I need to tidy up the nurse's office... It'd be nice if you came along."

day5_pending_react_nurse.name: Me
day5_pending_react_nurse.text: *Tidying the nurse's office on a weekend. Sounds like an excuse, but the reason doesn't matter. As long as I get to see her.*

day5_pending_reply_nurse.name: Me
day5_pending_reply_nurse.text: (Today, I'll tell her how I feel. "I'll be there. At the front gate." I replied.)

day5_pending_msg_teacher.name: Teacher
day5_pending_msg_teacher.text: "Can you come by school today? Help me with some paperwork. ...Don't read into it, it's nothing weird."

day5_pending_react_teacher.name: Me
day5_pending_react_teacher.text: ("Nothing weird"— that line hit harder than it should have. Is she feeling the same thing?)

day5_pending_reply_teacher.name: Me
day5_pending_reply_teacher.text: (If I don't say it today, there might not be a next time. "I'll be there!" I sent.)

day5_default_msg_start.name: Me
day5_default_msg_start.text: *I turned on my phone. New messages— none.*

day5_default_msg_scroll.name: Me
day5_default_msg_scroll.text: *I scrolled through my chat history. Conversations from the past few days lined up one after another.*

day5_default_msg_reflect.name: Me
day5_default_msg_reflect.text: *Seoyeon, Yuna, Dain, the nurse, the teacher... People I met after transferring here.*

day5_default_msg_reflect2.name: Me
day5_default_msg_reflect2.text: *They were all so warm to me. But in the end, I never managed to say what I really felt.*

day5_default_msg_resolve.name: Me
day5_default_msg_resolve.text: *An empty notification screen. But I don't want to end things like this.*

day5_default_msg_decide.name: Me
day5_default_msg_decide.text: *It's the last day. I'll at least walk around the school. Something might change.*

day5_morning_ready.name: Me
day5_morning_ready.text: *Time to get ready. I stood in front of the closet.*

day5_morning_closet.name: Me
day5_morning_closet.text: *It's Sunday, so no uniform needed. But what do I wear?*

day5_outfit_choice.name: Me
choices: Something a bit nicer *Today's kind of special*

day5_outfit_casual.name: Me
day5_outfit_casual.text: *A fresh shirt and jeans. Comfortable but put-together. Yeah, natural is the way to go.*

day5_outfit_special.name: Me
day5_outfit_special.text: *I picked things out more carefully than usual. One last mirror check. ...Not bad.*

day5_breakfast.name: Me
day5_breakfast.text: *Made a slice of toast. A quiet kitchen, birdsong outside. A proper Sunday morning scene.*

day5_outfit_check.name: Me
day5_outfit_check.text: *One final look in the mirror. Definitely different eyes from day one.*

day5_morning_items.name: Me
day5_morning_items.text: *Wallet, phone, keys. Standing at the front door.*

day5_morning_depart.name: Me
day5_morning_depart.text: *I opened the door. A spring breeze grazed my cheek. Beautiful weather.*

day5_walk_seoyeon_2.name: Me
day5_walk_seoyeon_2.text: *Seoyeon was already at the meeting spot. Standing in the sunlight, she was almost blinding.*

day5_walk_seoyeon_talk.name: Seoyeon
day5_walk_seoyeon_talk.text: "Nice weather. Even nicer walking together. Did you know this road gets cherry blossoms in spring?"

day5_walk_seoyeon_react.name: Me
day5_walk_seoyeon_react.text: *Walking side by side. Without a word, our strides naturally synced up. I like this kind of distance.*

day5_walk_couple_yuna.name: Me
day5_walk_couple_yuna.text: *Yuna was leaning against the wall at the meeting spot. One earbud in.*

day5_walk_yuna_talk.name: Me
day5_walk_yuna_talk.text: *Yuna pulled out one earbud and held it toward me. Listen together— no words needed.*

day5_walk_yuna_react.name: Me
day5_walk_yuna_react.text: *Sharing earbuds, walking side by side. Not a word between us, but the silence was comfortable. This is how it works with Yuna.*

day5_walk_dain_2.name: Me
day5_walk_dain_2.text: *Dain was waving both arms with everything she had from across the way. Where does that energy even come from this early?*

day5_walk_dain_talk.name: Dain
day5_walk_dain_talk.text: "Going to school on a Sunday is kinda hilarious, but since it's with you, it feels like a field trip! Let's go, let's go!!"

day5_walk_dain_react.name: Me
day5_walk_dain_react.text: *Dain grabbed my hand and pulled me along. Before I knew it, I was smiling too. That energy— it's contagious.*

day5_walk_couple_nurse.name: Me
day5_walk_couple_nurse.text: *The nurse was at the meeting spot in casual clothes. A completely different vibe from school.*

day5_walk_nurse_2.name: Nurse
day5_walk_nurse_2.text: "You made it. Seeing each other on the weekend feels different, doesn't it? You're used to the lab coat version of me."

day5_walk_nurse_talk.name: Nurse
day5_walk_nurse_talk.text: "This way's a shortcut. ...Also a path where we won't run into anyone we know."

day5_walk_nurse_react.name: Me
day5_walk_nurse_react.text: *That slightly shy expression was new. Just walking side by side, my heart felt like it might burst.*

day5_walk_couple_teacher.name: Me
day5_walk_couple_teacher.text: *Teacher was at the meeting spot in casual clothes. Nothing like the strict image from the classroom.*

day5_walk_teacher_2.name: Teacher
day5_walk_teacher_2.text: "I expected you to be late, but you're right on time. ...That's a compliment."

day5_walk_teacher_talk.name: Teacher
day5_walk_teacher_talk.text: "Walking together on a weekend— that's a first. Different from school, right? Right now I'm not a teacher. Just a person."

day5_walk_teacher_react.name: Me
day5_walk_teacher_react.text: ("Just a person." That single line set my chest on fire. I've never seen this side of her before.)

day5_walk_couple_common.name: Me
day5_walk_couple_common.text: *Walking side by side, we talked about everything. When we first met, the funny moments, the times my heart raced.*

day5_walk_couple_common2.name: Me
day5_walk_couple_common2.text: *The school came into view. I thought this was a goodbye, but today it's the start of a day together.*

day5_walk_pending_start.name: Me
day5_walk_pending_start.text: *I stepped out and headed toward the school.*

day5_walk_pending_think.name: Me
day5_walk_pending_think.text: *The words I couldn't say yesterday keep circling in my head. Today— no matter what.*

day5_walk_pending_plan.name: Me
day5_walk_pending_plan.text: (What do I even say? "I like you"? "Go out with me"? No, just read the moment and let it happen naturally...)

day5_walk_pending_nervous.name: Me
day5_walk_pending_nervous.text: *My palms are already damp. Every step forward, my heartbeat picks up.*

day5_walk_pending_resolve.name: Me
day5_walk_pending_resolve.text: *It's fine. I have four days of memories together. Those moments give me courage.*

day5_walk_pending_memory.name: Me
day5_walk_pending_memory.text: *The awkward greetings on day one, laughing over lunch, the after-school conversations. I replay them one by one.*

day5_walk_pending_ready.name: Me
day5_walk_pending_ready.text: *If I don't want regrets, I have to say it today. That much is certain.*

day5_walk_pending_almost.name: Me
day5_walk_pending_almost.text: *The school is just ahead. One deep breath.*

day5_walk_default_start.name: Me
day5_walk_default_start.text: *Walking alone on a Sunday morning street. Normally, I'd still be in bed at this hour.*

day5_walk_default_reflect.name: Me
day5_walk_default_reflect.text: *Before the transfer, Sunday mornings meant rolling around under the covers until they were over.*

day5_walk_default_change.name: Me
day5_walk_default_change.text: *But now it's different. Never thought I'd actually want to go to school on a Sunday.*

day5_walk_default_people.name: Me
day5_walk_default_people.text: *Seoyeon's composure, Yuna's stillness, Dain's spark, the nurse's warmth, the teacher's sincerity. Every one of them, a connection I'm grateful for.*

day5_walk_default_arrive.name: Me
day5_walk_default_arrive.text: *The school building comes into view up ahead. The same sight from my first day as a transfer student.*

day5_arrive_start.name: Me
day5_arrive_start.text: *I stood at the school's front gate.*

day5_arrive_nostalgia.name: Me
day5_arrive_nostalgia.text: *This gate. Five days ago, I stood in this exact spot when I first came to this school.*

day5_arrive_firstday.name: Me
day5_arrive_firstday.text: *Everything was unfamiliar back then. New school, new classroom, faces I didn't recognize. I was so nervous I could barely move my feet.*

day5_arrive_now.name: Me
day5_arrive_now.text: *It's different now. There are people I know here, and a place to come back to. I walked through the gate and inside.*
